scenes.purpose: Hook: Lernen fühlt sich schwer an, Scrollen leicht.
scenes.visual: Close-up of study desk, open notebook and laptop; smartphone next to the notes lights up with notifications and draws attention away from studying.
scenes.fallback: Top-down image of notebook, laptop and illuminated smartphone.

scenes.visual: Hand repeatedly reaches from textbook toward smartphone showing incoming notifications, short-form video feed or messaging screen without readable brands.
queries: phone social media scrolling close up
scenes.fallback: Generic phone notification illustration without brand logos.

scenes.visual: Fast sequence between notebook, laptop document and smartphone; hand alternates between all three to visualize context switching.
scenes.fallback: Split-screen style image showing notebook, laptop and smartphone.

scenes.purpose: Nach der Unterbrechung muss man wieder ins Thema finden.
scenes.visual: Person returns phone face down, stares at notes, searches through pages and tries to find the previous place again.
scenes.fallback: Close-up of finger searching through handwritten notes after putting phone away.

scenes.visual: Casual reflexive phone pickup: hand checks lock screen, unlocks device and begins scrolling almost automatically.
scenes.fallback: Generic close-up image of hand unlocking smartphone.

scenes.visual: Phone is deliberately placed in a drawer, backpack or another room; camera then returns to a clean study desk.
scenes.fallback: Phone placed face down far away from notebook.

scenes.visual: Close-up of generic smartphone settings where notification toggles are switched off; avoid identifiable app branding.
scenes.fallback: Minimal graphic of notification bell being switched off.

scenes.visual: Clean laptop workspace with one document or learning page open, unnecessary browser tabs being closed until only one task remains.
scenes.fallback: Laptop screen with one generic document and a clean desk.

scenes.visual: Study timer starts at 25 minutes beside notebook; learner begins writing while timer runs.
scenes.fallback: Simple 25:00 timer graphic next to notebook.

scenes.purpose: Eine Aufgabe, kein Scrollen, kein Tab-Wechsel.
scenes.visual: Focused writing and reading close-ups, steady hands, one notebook and one laptop window; phone is absent from frame.
queries: focused student writing notes close up
scenes.fallback: Calm close-up of handwritten notes and focused study materials.

scenes.purpose: Fokus als Umgebung statt Motivation darstellen.
scenes.visual: Before-and-after desk comparison: cluttered distracting setup transitions to clean minimal focus setup with phone removed.
scenes.fallback: Two contrasting desk images: distracted vs focused.

scenes.purpose: Ruhiger Abschluss: Lernen bleibt Arbeit, wird aber leichter.
scenes.visual: Calm final shot of productive study session, completed notes, laptop and a phone left far away or inside a bag.
scenes.fallback: Finished notes and tidy desk with phone out of reach.
